rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive cybersecurity training and incident response simulation capabilities. Generates adaptive adversary scenarios based on real APT profiles and CVEs, simulates multi-phase attacks, and produces detection artifacts including Sigma, Splunk, and KQL rules. Supports incident timeline reconstruction, digital forensics analysis, and integrates with MITRE ATT&CK framework. Includes governance features like RBAC, audit logging, and compliance reporting for professional security teams.
